metadata.short_desc: Watches your Bambu A1 in the background and pushes completion / pause / runout alerts
metadata.desc: Bind your Bambu Lab account and the plugin keeps watching the printer over MQTT. It pushes print started / paused / filament runout / finished / failed / offline events, and answers questions in natural language. Critical alerts never go through the LLM; only recaps, diagnosis, digests and Q&A do.

region.hint: The region used for the SMS code and for login must match, otherwise the code is rejected.

protocol_profile.hint: Switch profile instead of editing code when the cloud renames fields.

protocol_overrides.hint: Deep-merged into the profile; use it to patch a temporary cloud rename.

serial.hint: You can also run /banbu sn <serial> in chat.

secret_key.hint: Generated on first bind if empty. Changing it requires rebinding.

labels: Auto (stream first, fall back to polling)

stale_after.description: Mark offline after N seconds without data

push_targets.hint: By default messages go to the session that bound the account.

quiet_hours_enabled.hint: During quiet hours only critical events are pushed.

merge_window_s.hint: Events and the model draft inside the window are merged into one message; 0 disables merging.

llm_route.hint: Event -> direct/llm/both. Empty means built-in defaults.

llm_provider_id.hint: Empty uses the session default provider.

llm_budget_per_hour.hint: When exceeded the event falls back to the template, alerts are still delivered.

dryer.hint: Not implemented yet; interface and config placeholders only.
